## Featured Systems

- [TrustRAG](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/TrustRAG): Local-first 8-stage RAG reliability workbench (ONNX BGE-small + BM25 RRF, atomic claim decomposition, NLI verification, SHA-256 audit, bounded LangGraph recovery, MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 server, Ollama/llama.cpp/MLX, 750 test functions across 64 pytest modules + Vitest/Playwright/k6).
- [CareerOS-Pro](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/CareerOS-Pro): Self-hosted job-intelligence platform with deterministic normalization/deduplication, FastAPI 0.141, SQLAlchemy 2, MySQL 8, Qdrant 1.19, LangGraph 1.2 human-review interrupt, live URL scraping, Gemini grounding, and 261 collected pytest cases across 17 test suites.
- [ApplyOS](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/ApplyOS): Local-first multi-runtime job application framework (Bun 1.4.3 workspace, 14 providers, 9-gate deterministic ranker, LaTeX ATS PDF verification, 4 offline eval suites).
- [Agentic DocuChat](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/MCP_Agentic_DocuChat): Local-first PDF RAG (v3.2.1) with page-level citations, ChromaDB content-hash caching, Composio MCP tools, and 102 unit tests.
- [Resume Crew](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/Resume_Crew): Evidence-only resume-to-JD match reports (v1.4.0) with MLX-LM/Ollama local inference, 9 exported artifacts per run, Docker support, and 52 pytest functions across 8 modules.
- [SkillMap Agent](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/MCP_SkillMap_Agent) & [SalaryInsights Agent](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/MCP_SalaryInsights_Agent): Multi-turn CLI agents over Composio MCP and LangGraph memory (paired with CourseFinder and Email Inbox Summarizer).
